reviews.review: Originally I got this just to get the Team Fortress 2 hat, but once I started playing, I went further than the achievement to get the hat even required. It is really fun and a good co-op game for those who want a game to play with friends. There are some lag issues, which is because I think players have to host the games. Still, a really good, interesting, challenging game, which encourages teamwork but also some personal skill as well. Don't worry though, its easy to pick up and you should understand the basic mechanics pretty quickly. Would recommend.

[quote] [url=store.steampowered.com/curator/39449455][b]Truth[/b], [i]Doubt[/i] or [u]Lie[/u] - Steam Curator[/url] [/quote]

[b] Intro [/b]
[list]
It's absolutely mind-blowing good that I am shocked it's free to play. It's a fast paced game, full of action with decent graphics. Any computer will run it. No worry about that. So naturally, when I saw the game for the first time on the Steam store, I immediately called up my friends and for the next couple of hours we did not stop playing even for a minute.
[/list]
[b] Positive [/b]
[list]
The game is involves around killing creatures from hell or something like that. There are many difficulties, but so far I am stuck to insane difficulty on Mission 4 which is really intense. Game can be hard if you want to push yourself with your team. If not, you can always lower down the difficulty and enjoy casual play. On insane difficulty, we have played one mission for almost six hours in total. It can really test your skills. The animations (such as explosions, killing bugs and etc.) are done nicely. The story is simple - kill them all. Nothing more to write about that. Finally, there are many types of weapons to choose, eight types of characters and seven maps that are included in the co-op campaign. Also, you have an option to add bots.
[/list]
[b] Negative [/b]
[list]
I would say the negative things is that it's relatively short. I would have really liked that there are more maps and campaigns to play. Servers or rooms are usually empty. I tried posting in a community hub to find players for co-op experience. However, funny enough, I eventually found in the game lobby players to join me. I found two guys to help me finish a speed run which was my very first ever in any game. Absolutely amazing experience.
[/list]
[b] Verdict [/b] 
[list]
Overall, game is a must-play really. You will need teamwork and dedication to win. With friends, it's just an endless amount of fun. Laughing and screaming at each other - what is not to love. Check out my [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cjg0jH9V64I&t=32s] video [/url] with the highlights of the speed runs. And once again, thanks Medivaccum!
[/list]
